prompt: Announce the First Baptist church potluck as a WWE ring announcer. Full commitment.
response:
Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls, children of all ages and children of the LIVING GOD… THIS… IS… POTLUCK!

The time for testimony is OVER. The time for Tupperware has BEGUN. We are LIVE from the Fellowship Hall, and the air is thick with the aroma of a thousand casseroles and the ELECTRICITY of the Holy Ghost!

We have a SIX-WOMAN TAG-TEAM MATCH scheduled for one fall, one dish, and the GLORY OF GOD!

Introducing first, coming down the center aisle from the left side of the kitchen… She is the "Queen of Cream," the "Sultaness of Soup," the one woman wrecking crew with a crock-pot that has NEVER been returned empty… Put your hands together for DEBORAH "THE STEAMROLLER" HENDERSON and her CHICKEN AND WILD RICE SOUP! That’s a hot dish, brother!

And her partners… first, the culinary anarchist who brought a seven-layer salad in a bowl so deep you can see the bottom of the Jordan River… She is the "Proverbs 31 Princess of Produce," MARGARET "THE MAYONNAISE MAULER" PETERSON!

And the third member of this team… she’s got a green bean casserole with French-fried onions so crispy they can be heard from the cheap seats in the balcony… She is the "Missionary of Melted Cheese," the "Sister of Sodium," BARBARA "THE BAPTIST BOMBSHELL" WILKINS!

And their opponents… entering the Fellowship Hall to a chorus of gasps and the shaking of casserole lids… They are the reigning, defending, undisputed Heavyweight Champions of the Church Cookbook. They are the "Sisters of Soul Food," and they are led by the woman who makes a brisket so tender, it brought Deacon Jones to tears during the opening prayer… She is the "Matriarch of Meat," the "Hebrews 11 Heroine of the Hot Plate," EDITH "THE ENCHILADA EARTHQUAKE" JENKINS!

And her partners… first, a woman who has weaponized a jello mold with suspended mandarin oranges. She is the "Congealed Crusader," DORIS "THE DESSERT DECAPITATOR" MILL
